news.title: Local Veggie Vouchers Program marks 10 years serving Cedar Valley families and farmers
news.summary_en: As farmers market season hits full stride in the Cedar Valley, a local program connecting families with fresh, locally grown food is celebrating a major milestone with UNI's Veggie Vouchers Program.

news.title: Fastest-growing business jobs
news.summary_en: Majoring in business will open the door for many potential career opportunities! Rather than some majors that pigeonhole you into one very specific career, business gives you a lot of flexibility. This makes it a fantastic option if you don’t know exactly what kind of job you’d like to have, but you still have a general idea. news.title: New center at UNI serves as hub for continuing education and more for teachers, families, schools
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa plans to launch EdvantageUNI, a centralized hub for professional learning, educational growth and support for school districts, practicing and aspiring educators, and families.

news.title: UNI Wilson College of Business celebrates online MBA graduates
news.summary_en: Graduates of UNI’s online Master of Business Administration crossed the stage at the 2026 spring Commencement. The program attracts a wide variety of students, ranging from young professionals to seasoned business executives seeking the highly regarded MBA from the Wilson College of Business.

news.title: Pella Corporation’s Adam Farver to headline the 2026 Iowa Family Business Conference at Vermeer Corporation in Pella
news.summary_en: The family behind Pella Corporation, one of Iowa’s most iconic multigenerational companies, will headline the 2026 Iowa Family Business Conference in Pella on Nov. 11.
